title: A tier is renamed in place on its page and saved at once
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
  3. Click tier A's name at the top of the page.
  4. Type a new name no other tier uses.
  5. Press Enter.
  6. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  7. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  8. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Tier A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The title turns into a name field holding tier A's name.

Step 4:

  • The field shows the new name.

Step 5:

  • The title shows the new name with no Save button needed.

Step 6:

  • The Tiers list shows the new name in tier A's row, same number.

Step 7:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 8:

  • Tier A's column header shows its number and the new name.
